claims.claim: Northrop Grumman reported $20 billion of Q2 2026 net awards and a record $105 billion backlog, a demand signal for long-cycle aerospace and defense capacity.

risks.risk: Backlog strength does not guarantee margin realization; program execution, fixed-price exposure and government budget timing remain material.

unknowns.unknown: Program-level backlog conversion and margin mix require deeper underwriting.

claims.claim: Q2 2026 sales rose 5% year over year to $10.9 billion and management raised full-year sales and MTM-adjusted EPS guidance while reaffirming operating-income and adjusted-free-cash-flow guidance.

risks.risk: Raised guidance remains forward-looking and sensitive to program execution and U.S. government funding.

unknowns.unknown: No independent customer-side validation was acquired in this Scout pass.
